subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration fit + next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration fit + next steps

Jordan — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and recommended next steps so we have alignment.

Key pain points you described:
- High latency on your current generation endpoints at 99th percentile (500–700ms) impacting chat UX.
- Rising per-token costs for embeddings and reranking across your search and personalization pipelines.
- Need for streaming responses for live chat and deterministic structured outputs for downstream processing.
- Constraints around SDK/agent integration: existing infra uses our SDKs but needs function-calling and structured outputs (JSON) to wire into your orchestration.

Business goals:
- Reduce tail latency to <250ms for short-form chat (under 1024 tokens) while keeping cost per session flat.
- Centralize embeddings generation and reranking to improve relevance by 10–15% without doubling costs.
- Proof-of-concept (PoC) within ~6 weeks to validate integration and SLA targets.

Product fit summary (how Redwood maps to those goals):
- Streaming + Function calling: our SDK supports streaming token-by-token + structured function-calling (JSON schema enforcement) so you can pipe actions to your event handler with deterministic output.
- Structured outputs: Redwood's response schema helpers (and safety filters) reduce parsing errors and downstream exceptions during ingestion.
- Embeddings & reranking: we recommend staged batching + prefix caching and our quantized model options for lower inference cost with comparable embedding quality.
- SDK changes: we discussed a small client-side change to adopt the v2 call signature (examples in the playbook) — mostly replacing sync calls with the streaming iterator and updating a single helper for function callbacks.

Numbers we discussed (ballpark)
- Expected 99p latency improvement: 30–60% depending on batch sizing and KV-cache hit rate.
- Embeddings cost delta: ~20% lower with dynamic batching and GPU pooling vs current host.

Attachments I've included: integration playbook and an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones (PoC, security review, procurement).

Proposed next steps
1) Technical deep-dive with your engineering + our solutions architect (30–45m) — proposed Tue Oct 12, 10:00 AM PT.
2) Share PoC scoping doc and access requirements (we'll need a small test dataset and VPN/KMS details if you want private deployment).
3) Procurement intro: please loop in your procurement contact (you mentioned Sally Park) so we can share the preliminary commercial terms.

If this looks right I will: share a calendar invite for Oct 12, upload the playbook to the HubSpot deal record, and loop PrIyom from our infra team for the technical call.

Thanks again — excited to partner.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0192
redwood.inference

Attachments: redwood-integration-playbook.pdf (attached), acme-mvp-map.xlsx (attached)

Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood integration fit + next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is great and captures the conversation. A few quick clarifications:
- Data residency: for the PoC we need to ensure logs and embeddings are stored in us-west only. Can you confirm Redwood supports region pinning for both hosted and dedicated modes?
- Latency targets: can you share a short one-pager with sample 95/99 latency numbers on models you recommend for short-chat + embedding workloads?
- Cost: we need a rough cost estimate for 100k monthly sessions + 1M embeddings/month (ballpark) so procurement can budget.

Sally — looping you in for procurement and contract timing. We hope to have procurement review within 2 weeks.

I can do the technical deep-dive Tue Oct 12 at 10am PT — please send an invite.

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Sally.

Confirming action items from our side:
- I'll send a calendar invite for Tue Oct 12, 10:00 AM PT and include Priyom (solutions infra) and Vivek (product) so we can cover SDK changes + model recommendations.
- I'll upload the short latency one-pager and a cost-estimate snapshot to the HubSpot deal ASAP (link below).
- Playbook + MAP attached for your review; the playbook includes sample SDK diffs (swap sync -> streaming iterator), function-calling examples, and a sample JSON schema for structured outputs used by a similar customer.

Quick snippet from the playbook (streaming + function-calling):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v2/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-stream-1","stream":true,"functions":[{"name":"extract_entities","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"org":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'

This will return a streaming response with function triggers that your client can consume and call into internal services. The playbook shows a node/python SDK example too.

Talk soon — invite coming in a minute.
